missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative predicate. 'Праздник' is a masculine noun staying in the nominative as the predicate. 'Большой' and 'народный' are the agreeing masculine adjectives, and 'завтра' sets the time.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Праздник' is the accusative direct object of 'отмечаем', identical to the nominative for this inanimate masculine noun. 'Весело' describes the manner.
Strategic focus: Genitive with preposition. 'Праздника' takes the genitive after 'до' to mean before the holiday. 'Три дня' is the time phrase, and 'осталось' is the impersonal predicate.
Strategic focus: Dative with preposition. 'Празднику' takes the dative after 'к' to mean preparing for. 'Большому' agrees in the masculine dative, and 'все' is the subject.
Strategic focus: Instrumental case. 'Праздником' is the instrumental after 'довольны'. 'Весёлым' agrees in the masculine instrumental, and 'дети' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Prepositional of location. 'Празднике' is the prepositional after 'на' to show where it happened. 'Гостей' is genitive plural after 'много', and 'было' is the impersonal predicate.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Праздники' is the nominative plural subject of 'бывают', taking the -и ending after the stem in -к. 'Весёлые' agrees, and 'зимой' sets the season.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after quantity. 'Праздников' is the genitive plural after 'много', taking the -ов ending. 'Государственных' agrees in the plural, and 'в году' gives the frame.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Празднике' is the prepositional after 'о' to express the topic. 'Любимом' agrees in the masculine prepositional, and 'говорим' introduces discussion.
Strategic focus: Nominative description. 'Праздник' is nominative as the subject. 'Важный' is the agreeing masculine adjective, reinforced by 'очень'. A clean descriptive model.
